description: This file defines a React component for displaying a monograph page, including features like table of contents, encryption handling, and user interactions such as reporting and scrolling.

methods.name: generateTableOfContents
methods.description: Generates a table of contents based on the headings in the document.

methods.name: MonographPage
methods.description: Main React component for displaying a monograph, including header, content, table of contents, and footer.

methods.name: MonographLockscreen
methods.description: Component for handling encrypted monograph unlocking via password input.

methods.name: ScrollToTopButton
methods.description: Button component that scrolls the page to the top when clicked.

methods.name: ResponsiveTitle
methods.description: Displays the monograph title, with behavior to show/hide based on scroll position.

methods.name: TableOfContents
methods.description: Component rendering the list of headings for navigation.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string to Base64 URL-safe format.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 URL-safe string back to original.

methods.name: toBase64Url
methods.description: Converts standard Base64 string to URL-safe Base64.

methods.name: fromBase64Url
methods.description: Converts URL-safe Base64 string back to standard Base64.

methods.name: unlockMonograph
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted monograph content using provided password.
